**Everything on this site runs inside your web browser.** No installation, no account, no upload. Windows, Mac, Chromebook and iPad all behave the same. The first code cell on a page takes 10–30 seconds to start (it downloads Python or R once); after that, cells run instantly.

## Python or R?

- **Lab 1** is done in **both** languages, so that you can read either one.
- **From Lab 2 on**, choose **one**. Every exercise still shows both; use the *Show code in* bar at the top of the lab page to hide the language you are not using.

## How to use this site

1. Click **Run Code** in any grey cell. Edit the code and run it again; nothing you do here can break anything.
2. Every lab exercise has a **Hint** and a **Solution** button. Try before you click.
3. Variables stay in memory until you reload the page. After a reload, run the lab's setup cells again.
4. To keep your work, copy your code into a text file, or follow the [Setup](setup.qmd) page to run the same code on your own laptop in Jupyter or RStudio.
5. ChatGPT is allowed (TRACE prompting). Copilot-style autocomplete is **not** used in the labs: the point is to read every line.
